items.topic: agent-docs are imported once from template 5bddd8b^, then owned by judo-blueprint
items.claim: Plan said agent-docs are re-synced continuously from the project template (feature/JNG-6380_cli_guidance), with agent-docs-sync/parity scripts.
items.fact: The project template deleted its agent-docs on 2026-11-03 (commit 5bddd8b on develop; proposal says 'The guides are maintained in judo-blueprint'). So: one-time import from 5bddd8b^ (70 docs outside domain/), resolve Handlebars to static markdown, remove Claude/skill wording, merge cciu additions, drop domain/. Afterwards judo-blueprint owns them. No skill contains the import (scripts live in openspec/changes/restructure-blueprints-for-kb/oneoff/); judo-catalog-maintain covers only blueprints and best practices; the agent-docs-sync spec is replaced by agent-docs-catalog and template parity gate removed from check-all.

items.topic: A/B evaluation and reconstruction of blueprints dropped
items.fact: A/B evaluation and reconstruction of blueprints in real projects is not planned (design.md:36). agent-docs come first (phase P1b, task group 3); judo-ng is checked only for agent-docs.

items.topic: Every agent-docs change requires an accepted finding in review.md
items.fact: Workflow: subagents verify docs vs judo-ng and record findings (claim, verdict correct/wrong/outdated/missing, code location repo@sha:path:line, proposed text); operator reviews every finding in one review.md (accept/reject/edit); a @coding subagent applies only accepted ones, one PR per area. A doc change without an accepted finding fails review. A sweep that notices an agent-docs problem lists it in its PR for review and does not edit docs.

items.topic: Add testing/ and operations/ best-practice folders? (open question)
items.claim: Best practices split only model 71 / backend 74 / frontend 62.
items.fact: Proposal: add testing/ and operations/ folders and sweep lanes (5 lanes: model, backend, frontend, testing, operations; schema migrations move to operations); keep security/access/integration as category: tags. Rackinspect has test 344 files, e2e 221, 18 migration steps, docker 35, enviroments 208. Recorded as open question in design.md, decided after first rackinspect sweep by counting candidates forced into three layers.

items.topic: Role map used by the plan (preset Anthropic)
items.fact: @explore=claude-haiku-5-5 low (sweep explorers), @review=local muse-spark-1.3 (cross-validate; fall back to @research if too weak), @coding=sonnet-5-5 high (entries, fragments, applying accepted findings), @naming=haiku (neutral names), @research=sonnet-5-5 (one-time judo-ng checks). Role->model table lives in design.md; update it if role map changes. Operator chose: 'use explore! ... use 4 parallel subagents then check what was done'.

items.topic: Verify against clean origin/develop worktrees, not local checkouts
items.fact: Most judo-ng local checkouts are detached or dirty (e.g. judo-meta-esm dirty=25, sdk-core dirty=24), so evidence is not reproducible. Create read-only git worktrees at origin/develop for each repo under target/agent-docs-review/judo-ng, record commits in judo-ng.lock (e.g. judo-meta-esm b78cc703, judo-model-cli 9f6a4bd, judo-runtime-core b9bd93e8, judo-ui-react-template ad0848bc, judo-ui-e2e-template 2b3e9b3). Add target/ to .git/info/exclude; remove worktrees with git worktree remove afterward (they register in judo-ng repos). Extract template docs with git archive 5bddd8b^.

items.topic: Haiku-low explorer subagents report partial passes as done; enforce coverage
items.claim: 4 @explore subagents verified agent-docs and returned findings.
items.fact: All four self-reported partial passes: only 38 of 70 docs checked (integration-testing 1/8, model 10/19, frontend 10/16), ~197 claims checked vs ~5,056 identifiers named in docs; 2,053 identifiers not found anywhere in judo-ng (backend 57%, integration-testing 56%, frontend 42%, deployment 41%, e2e 26%, model 14%). Open-ended instructions ('extract claims and check') let them pick easy claims. Lessons: measure coverage with a script, require a verdict per inventory item, one doc per subagent, reject incomplete results; verify subagent findings (cited lines exist, absence claims re-grepped across all repos); proposed fixes can be wrong. Not-found identifiers fall in 3 groups: names generated from example model (entityDao, UserForCreate, withEmail), external libraries (getByTestId, toBeVisible), truly nonexistent platform APIs.

items.topic: Operator: the check was too shallow, read through the whole judo-ng
items.claim: Agent proposed building an identifier inventory script and having subagents check only unfound suspects.
items.fact: Operator rejected the lookup-by-name approach: 'Not like this read through the whole judo-ng'. Verification must come from reading all judo-ng source (103 repos; 26 over 400KB need splitting by module) and building platform knowledge from it, not name grep. Operator also challenged 'Are you sure wasn't it too fast?'
React template writes generated files to src/containers/... (ui-react.yaml:827); typescript-rest template writes to data-service/ (ui-typescript-rest.yaml:4-16).

items.topic: Business errors: ExceptionUtils/BusinessErrorException are not platform classes
items.claim: throw ExceptionUtils.createBusinessErrorException(...); GenericOperationErrorException and BusinessErrorException are runtime exception types. Subagent's proposed fix: use runtime ValidationException/AccessDeniedException/NotFoundException.
items.fact: ExceptionUtils is rackinspect project code (hu.blackbelt.rackinspect.common.utils); BusinessErrorException is generated from the project's own model (e.g. rackinspect api...error_services.businesserror.BusinessErrorException). JUDO way: model business errors as operation faults (esm.ecore:584); the generator creates the exception class. Runtime exceptions ValidationException, AccessDeniedException, NotFoundException exist in judo-runtime-core .../runtime/core/exception/. The subagent's proposed text was wrong.

JudoTest lives in ...guice.testkit.fixture; TransactionHandling is nested inside JudoTest; the extension resolves JudoRuntimeFixture (JudoTestFixture does not exist); manual mode uses beginTransaction/commitTransaction/rollbackTransaction and DAOs come from getInjector().
AUTO_ROLLBACK javadoc says tables are not truncated. Medium confidence; verify against JudoTestExtension before editing.
